spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Alustriel casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 22}):

On a failed save, la cible has the {@conditionincapacité} condition until the start of Alustriel's next turn. On a successful save, la cible's speed is reduced by 10 mètres until the start of Alustriel's next turn.

Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 22}Dextérité saving throw, taking 77 ({@dégât 14d10}) radiantdgts on a failed save or half as muchdgts on a successful one. Additionally, Alustriel or une créature of her choice within 60 mètres of her then regains 10 ({@dice 3d6})touché points.

entries: Brilliant silver fire harmlessly wreathes Alustriel and empowers her. The silver fire lasts for 1 hour or until she has the {@condition incapacitated} condition or uses another bonus action to quench it. While wreathed in silver fire, Alustriel gains truesight within 30 feet and can use her Argent Blaze action. In addition, Alustriel is unaffected by magic that would ascertain her alignment, creature type, thoughts, or truthfulness.

reaction.name: Shining Counterspell
entries: Alustriel interrupts a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself that is casting a spell. If the spell is 5th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 6th level or higher, Alustriel makes an Intelligence check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) radiant damage if the spell fails.

trait.name: Undying
entries: If Vecna is slain, his soul refuses to accept its fate and lives on as a disembodied spirit that fashions a new body for itself after {@dice 1d100} years. Vecna's new body appears within 100 kilomètres of where he was slain. When the new body is complete, Vecna regains all histouché points and becomes active again.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vecna uses Flight of the Damned (if available), Rotten Fate, or Spellcasting. He then makes two attacks with Afterthought.

action.name: Afterthought
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d4 + 5}) piercingdgts plus 9 ({@dégât 2d8}) necroticdgts. If la cible is une créature, it is afflicted by entropic magic, taking 9 ({@dégât 2d8}) necroticdgts at the start of each of its turns. Immediately after taking thisdgts on its turn, la cible doit faire a {@dd 20}jet de sauvegarde Constitution, ending the effect on itself on a success. Until it succeeds on this save, the afflicted target can't regaintouché points.

action.name: Flight of the Damned {@recharge 5}
entries: Vecna conjures a torrent of flying, spectral entities that fill a 120-foot cone and pass through all creatures in that area before dissipating. Each creature in that area doit faire a {@dd 22}jet de sauvegarde Constitution. On a failed save, la créature takes 36 ({@dégât 8d8}) necroticdgts and has the {@condition effrayé} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, la créature takes half as muchdgts only. A {@condition effrayé} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Rotten Fate
entries: Vecna causes necrotic magic to engulf une créature he can see within 120 mètres of himself. The target doit faire a {@dd 22}jet de sauvegarde Constitution, taking 96 ({@dégât 8d8 + 60}) necroticdgts on a failed save or half as muchdgts on a successful one. A Humanoid killed by this magic rises as a zombie at the start of Vecna's next turn and acts immediately after Vecna in the initiative order. The zombie is under Vecna's control.

bonus.name: Vile Teleport
entries: Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. He can cause each creature of his choice within 15 feet of his destination space to take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage. If at least one creature takes this damage, Vecna regains 80 hit points.

reactionHeader: Vecna can take up to three reactions per round but only one per turn.

reaction.name: Dread Counterspell
entries: Vecna utters a dread word to interrupt a creature he can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 4th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 5th level or higher, Vecna makes an Intelligence check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage if the spell fails.

reaction.name: Fell Rebuke
entries: In response to being hit by an attack, Vecna utters a fell word, dealing 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage to the attacker, and Vecna teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

trait.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The vlazok can't be surprised.

trait.name: Blood Frenzy
entries: The vlazok avantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all itstouché points.

trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The vlazok avantage aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The vlazok can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vlazok makes two Gore attacks.

action.name: Corne
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}23 ({@dégât 4d8 + 5}) piercingdgts, and if la cible is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition à terre} condition.

bonus.name: Stomp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The warforged makes two Armblade attacks.

action.name: Armblade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d6 + 3}) slashingdgts.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} pour toucher, allonge 5 m, or portée 30/120 m,, une cible. {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d6 + 3}) piercingdgts.

reaction.name: Protection
entries: When an attacker the warforged can see makes an attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of the warforged, the warforged can impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Fausse apparence
entries: Si  chandelier is motionless at the start of combat, it avantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if une créature hasn't observed the chandelier move or act, that creature doit réussir on a {@dd 18}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the chandelier is animate.

trait.name: Fiery Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 mètres of the chandelier takes 7 ({@dégât 2d6}) firedgts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The chandelier makes three Chain attacks, three Lamp attacks, or a combination thereof.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 15 m,, une cible. {@h}13 ({@dégât 2d8 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts, and la cible doit réussir on a {@dd 15}Force saving throw or be pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 mètres of the chandelier.

action.name: Lamp
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}9 ({@dégât 2d4 + 4}) bludgeoningdgts plus 13 ({@dégât 3d8}) firedgts.

action.name: Blazing Vortex {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 20 mètres of the chandelier and not behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} doit réussir on a {@dd 14}jet de sauvegarde Constitution or take 36 ({@dégât 8d8}) firedgts and have the {@condition aveuglé} condition until the start of the chandelier's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Windfall casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 23}):

trait.name: Dazzling Visage
entries: A brilliant array of chromatic colors emanates from Windfall, causing attack rolls against her to have disadvantage. This trait ceases to function while Windfall has the {@conditionincapacité} condition or has a speed of 0.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Windfall fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Windfall wears an iridescent magic coat that was tailored specifically for her and imbued with Tiamat's power. When she dies, the coat functions as a {@item Robe of Scintillating Colors}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Windfall makes two Chromatic Rapier attacks and uses Dragon's Fury once.

action.name: Chromatic Rapier
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} pour toucher, allonge 5 m,, une cible. {@h}11 ({@dégât 1d8 + 7}) piercingdgts plus 21 ({@dégât 6d6}) acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poisondgts (Windfall's choice).

action.name: Dragon's Fury
entries: Windfall targets une créature she can see within 60 mètres of herself and unleashes a burst of magical ire. The target doit faire a {@dd 23}Sagesse saving throw. On a failed save, la cible takes 36 ({@dégât 8d8}) psychicdgts and has the {@condition effrayé} condition until the start of Windfall's next turn. On a successful save, la cible takes half as muchdgts only.

bonus.name: Stunning Scintillation {@recharge 5}
entries: Windfall emits an overwhelming array of colors from her coat. Each creature within 30 feet of Windfall that can see her must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition stunned} condition until the start of Windfall's next turn.

legendary.name: Deft Dance
entries: Windfall moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Dragon's Flare
entries: Windfall flares with multicolored flames and targets une créature she can see within 30 mètres of herself. The target doit faire a {@dd 23}Dextérité saving throw. On a failed save, la cible takes 26 ({@dégât 4d12})dgts of a type chosen by Windfall: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, la cible takes half as muchdgts.

legendary.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Windfall uses Spellcasting.
